description: This file contains a function `get_merge_query` that generates SQL queries for merging modules in SuiteCRM, specifically handling contacts, opportunities, and accounts. It includes predefined select and where query templates for different module relationships, utilizing object properties and methods to dynamically construct queries based on seed object and related modules.

methods.name: get_merge_query
methods.description: Generates a SQL SELECT query to retrieve related record data for merging modules based on the supplied seed object, target module, and record key.
